purpose: Playable 3D surface maps, not promotional screenshots
runtime: Three shared 1024px WebP diffuse surface maps and one 1536x768px sky panorama

briefs.ivy: seamless dense overlapping teal ivy with tiny golden autumn accents, animated-film tactile detail
briefs.paving: seamless orthographic irregular lavender grey cobblestones, rounded edges and narrow mossy mortar
briefs.stone: seamless frontal lavender garden masonry, worn rounded blocks and moss joints
briefs.sky: panoramic lavender and indigo clouds, warm twilight horizon and delicate stars, no land or props
